description:
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing Scholar of the Ages, adding {B}{B} and then an amount of additional {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Scholar of the Ages from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Burnt Offering and another instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
